c.tagline: Moravia's student capital — functionalist landmarks and a beer-fuelled buzz.

taxi.fareNote: Metered — use registered cabs or a ride-hailing app to avoid overcharging.

emergency.note: 112 is the EU-wide emergency number connecting to all services; 158 reaches the police and 155 the ambulance directly.

avoid.reason: Minor pickpocketing around the main train station and on busy trams; otherwise very calm.

hood_desc: Brno's compact, walkable historic core, centered on Freedom Square (náměstí Svobody) and the Cabbage Market, crowned by Špilberk Castle and the Cathedral of St. Peter and Paul; nearly all the main sights, bars, and restaurants are here, making it the natural base for first-timers.
A youthful, bohemian quarter just northwest of the center, dense with student bars, cafes, and cheaper apartment rentals; along with the adjoining center it holds Brno's liveliest nightlife.

The historic 'Old Brno' district on the slopes south of the center, home to the Augustinian abbey where Gregor Mendel ran his genetics experiments, the Old Brno basilica, and the Starobrno brewery; traditional and calm, a short walk or tram from the sights.

An upscale, largely residential district north of the center with a strong community feel, the Botanical Garden, family-friendly streets, and quick tram links downtown; a relaxed choice for families or longer stays.
A green, hilly residential area west of the center bordering the Wilson Forest (Wilsonův les); leafy and quiet, well connected by tram, suited to travelers who want calm over buzz.

water.note: Czech tap water is safe and good quality.

transit.hours: Trams (locally 'šalina'), trolleybuses, and buses run roughly 4:30am-11pm; a network of night trams and buses runs through the small hours, meeting hourly at the main square.
transit.pay: Tap a contactless bank card or phone directly on the reader when boarding, or buy tickets from vehicle/stop machines or the Poseidon/Pubtran app; validate on boarding. A 15-minute ticket is about 20 CZK (~$0.90) and a 24-hour pass about 99 CZK (~$4.30).

air: Vienna Int'l (VIE) — ~120 km, used for wider connections
bus: Grand bus terminal (near the main railway station)

transit.m: Bus E76 to Brno hlavní nádraží / main station (~16 min)
Night bus N89 to the main station (all night)

tip.r: ~10% for good service in restaurants; round up for taxis and casual spots.
